notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three other Islands.
You control at least two additional creatures.
description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle and Mystic Sanctuary by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Gaea's Cradle and Mystic Sanctuary.
Gaea's Cradle and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, triggering Aesi twice and Mystic Sanctuary.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve both Aesi triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
